svg.title: Ampersand B, pixel-fit end mark for 17 px text, fit A: 14 px tall, 13 wide. Its top row sits on the capitals' top row and its tail one row under the baseline, the master's overshoot kept, as today's end mark sits (DR-130). Set it with vertical-align -1 px, half an em after the period. Drawn on the pixel grid, one outline (DR-142, stage B). Treatment D for Prussian: one color, White
